data.title: Pope preaches ‘dignity and peace’ in Paris
data.description: PARIS - Pope Leo XIV said on Saturday it was possible to “live together in dignity and peace” as he met migrants in Paris, ahead of a giant open-air mass expected to gather hundreds of thousands of people on the iconic Champs Elysees.

data.title: Nepal tunnel survivor wants to help post-flood rebuild
data.description: KIRTIPUR , Nepal - Pulled alive 10 days after catastrophic floods trapped him in a tunnel, Nepali hydropower worker Kabir Maharjan is determined to help rebuild his country despite his own harrowing ordeal.

data.title: Indonesia fires threaten critically endangered orangutans
data.description: JAKARTA - Wildfires that tore through Indonesian Borneo's vast tropical forests have piled pressure on critically endangered Bornean orangutans, the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) said on Saturday.

data.title: Iran proposes Hormuz plan, Trump reportedly refuses
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - Iran offered a plan to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz, Tehran said Friday, but within hours reports indicated that US President Donald Trump rejected the proposal.

data.title: Lula bans sports betting days ahead of Brazil's election
data.description: SAO PAULO — Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on Friday banned sports betting sites, the biggest sponsor of the country's football clubs, just days before a nailbiter election in which he is seeking a fourth term.

data.title: Daytime Russian attacks kill seven in Kyiv
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian strikes on Kyiv during the day killed seven people on Friday, including a 14-year-old boy, local authorities said, as Ukraine's leader disclosed that Donald Trump had approved licences for Patriot air-defence systems.

data.title: Russia not preparing for conflict with Europe, Putin says
data.description: SAINT PETERSBURG - Russia is not preparing for "any kind" of conflict with Europe, President Vladimir Putin said Friday, following warnings from some European NATO members of potential Russian attacks on the alliance's territory.

data.title: Trump, Xi inspect founding documents of US democracy to close summit
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump took Xi Jinping to see the founding documents of American democracy on Friday as the Chinese leader's state visit wrapped up with more pageantry but limited progress.

data.title: Six missing after building blast in historic Athens district
data.description: ATHENS - Six people including three tourists were missing after an explosion early Friday in a building in Athens' historic Plaka district located just below the Acropolis.

data.title: Conditions in Western Sahara camps ‘deteriorating’
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - The United Nations’ top official for refugees warned on Friday that conditions for long-displaced people in Western Sahara were getting worse and that their humanitarian needs were starkly underfunded.

data.title: Security Council condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - The United Nations Security Council on Friday condemned escalating attacks on Saudi Arabia by Yemeni Houthi rebels in a rare show of unity from the UN’s top body.

data.title: Concerns mount over ‘missing’ explorer Ranulph Fiennes
data.description: LONDON - Mystery has engulfed the fate of legendary British adventurer Ranulph Fiennes, after relatives and friends went public claiming he was missing and his wife was isolating him — with one reportedly even asking King Charles for help.

data.title: UN Security Council condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - The United Nations Security Council on Friday condemned escalating attacks on Saudi Arabia by Yemeni Houthi rebels in a rare show of unity from the UN's top body.

data.title: ‘We’re either idealists or idiots’, says co-author of Putin book
data.description: PARIS - When two FBI agents showed up on the doorstep of Roman Badanin’s California home in the autumn of 2025, they were smiling but the message they delivered was troubling.

data.title: Children return to Lebanese school destroyed by Israeli strike
data.description: BURJ QALAWAY, Lebanon - In southern Lebanon, eight-year-old Yara Ajami started the academic year this week in a doorless, windowless classroom after her school was destroyed by an Israeli strike.

data.title: South Lebanon children return to school destroyed by Israel strike
data.description: BURJ QALAWAY (LEBANON) - In southern Lebanon, eight-year-old Yara Ajami started the academic year this week in a doorless, windowless classroom after her school was destroyed by an Israeli strike.

data.title: Jewish group urges Berlin leftists to tackle antisemitism
data.description: BERLIN - The main Jewish community group in Germany has urged the far-left Die Linke to tackle antisemitism in its ranks as the party seeks to take power in Berlin following an election victory.

data.title: Passengers evacuated from ANA plane in Okinawa after midair engine trouble
data.description: Passengers were evacuated from an All Nippon Airways plane at Naha Airport in Okinawa prefecture on Wednesday night after it encountered engine trouble midair and returned, the Japanese airline said.

data.title: US miner KoBold bets on AI to gain edge in DR Congo mineral hunt
data.description: MANONO — Geologists from US mining company KoBold Metals are pushing deep into the Congolese bush, hoping a cutting-edge army of "explorers" directed by artificial intelligence (AI) will help give them an edge in the race for critical minerals.

data.title: India's 'Tree Father' plants for a greener future
data.description: NOIDA — With Delhi's choking haze hanging overhead, Peepal Baba presses a young tree into the earth, continuing a nearly half-century mission to restore India's vanishing green cover.

data.title: Cash for nature protection: hotelier's offer to Principe islanders
data.description: SANTO ANTONIO (SAO TOME AND PRINCIPE) — On the paradise island of Principe, a lush jungle haven in the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Guinea, a South African multimillionaire is offering locals a financial dividend to preserve the natural beauty on which his luxury tourism business depends.

data.title: At UN, Netanyahu defends Israel as delegates walk out
data.description: NEW YORK — Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu mounted a forceful defence of Israel's actions in the region at the United Nations (UN) on Thursday, seeking ​to counter growing international isolation ahead of elections he could lose, as dozens of delegates streamed out.

data.title: Internet disrupted in Ethiopia as conflict rages
data.description: ADDIS ABABA — The internet was disrupted in northern Ethiopia on Friday, online monitor Netblocks said, as conflict raged between the federal government and Tigray rebels, while Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) confirmed connection difficulties.
